subject.title: refactor(plugin-sdk): isolate core session state from plugin mutations

question: Should OpenClaw break the shipped `getAcpSessionManager()` class-identity contract immediately to close the private-session-state escape path, or require a versioned transition?
rationale: Preserving the real manager identity retains the escape path, while replacing it immediately breaks a released third-party Plugin SDK contract; repository policy cannot resolve that tradeoff without owner intent.

options.title: Version the safe facade
options.body: Add a new versioned safe getter or subpath, document deprecation and removal of the unsafe class-return contract, and remove it at the approved major boundary.

options.title: Approve immediate break
options.body: Explicitly approve the facade replacement as a security-boundary exception and publish clear migration guidance for affected plugins.

recommendation.title: Version the safe facade
recommendation.body: Add a new versioned safe getter or subpath, document deprecation and removal of the unsafe class-return contract, and remove it at the approved major boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a cross-cutting Plugin SDK compatibility and security-boundary decision rather than a mechanical implementation choice.
